description: Manage Novel save files: create, resume, switch, end, rename, description, info, genre, complete_session_zero, save_context, get_context, and list. list returns one line per Novel unless detail is set, and filter selects active, archived, or all. create and save_context persist to the Novel; list, info, and get_context are read-only. Lifecycle changes are not reversible via manage_history, so clone a Novel with manage_archive before a risky change. Use when: handling a campaign's lifecycle or returning to saved context. Do NOT use when: managing content inside the Novel — use the entity tools; use manage_archive for export, import, archive/unarchive, clone/branch, and checkpoints.

action.description: create, resume, switch, end, export, import, rename, description, list, archive, unarchive, info, genre, complete_session_zero, clone, branch, save_context, get_context, checkpoint_set, checkpoint_list, checkpoint_restore, or checkpoint_remove.

from_event.description: Event-log ordinal to branch from (branch; default latest).

include_checkpoints.description: Include checkpoints in export (default false; export).

new_name.description: Name for the copy or branch (clone/branch).

source_slug.description: Novel to copy or branch from (clone/branch).

trim_audit_sessions.description: Keep only the most recent N sessions' audit entries in the clone (clone; default full copy).

name: manage_novel

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Novel Save Management
